title: Overlays with names

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Identify a speaker without obscuring the subject or subtitles so the viewer can connect a name to a person.
strategic_value: Consistent name overlays can make Helsinki interviews easier to follow across different footage.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture compares names directly over footage, names above subtitles, and names on full-width or compact color backgrounds.
practical_value: Choose placement, contrast and background extent after checking the footage and subtitle area.

content_islands.name: Name-placement guidance
content_islands.spec: Introduce corner options and the preference for text directly on footage.

content_islands.name: Five examples
content_islands.spec: Stack white and colored names, subtitle-aware placement and two background treatments with captions.

ingredient.name: Name overlay
ingredient.application: Normally place text directly on video; add a color background when needed. Position the lower-third name above subtitles.
ingredient.scope: Video name overlays; direct-text examples use 150/180 px type/leading, background example 100/120 px.

reference_purposes.Application: Examples show direct text, subtitle-aware lower thirds and background panels.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Name overlays remain in the protected area.
reference_purposes.Expression: The static specimens compare names on interiors, outdoor scenes and green panels.
